_authoringNotes: WO-2004 - THE HEART LADDER, MOVED OUT OF CODE. Until 2026-09-06 the two numbers that define the realm-progression spine were C# literals: VillageTierService.MaxTier = 3 and NextCost() = 250 * next. They now live here and NOWHERE else; HeartProgressionCatalog is their only reader and VillageTierService projects them. Owner rules on balance - the values below are IDENTICAL to the constants they replaced (250 / 500 / 750, ceiling 3), so this file is a de-hardcoding, not a re-balance. WHAT THIS FILE DELIBERATELY DOES NOT CARRY, and why (measured at source 2026-09-06, do not add these speculatively): (1) DURATION - VillageTierService.TryUpgrade is INSTANT (spend -> tier+1 -> Save -> Recompute); there is no Heart job kind, no queue channel and no timer. WO-2003 recorded that as an owner gap and it is still unruled. (2) PREREQUISITE CONDITIONS beyond the crystal cost - none exist in the live spend path. (3) UNLOCK LISTS - buildings, troops, research, defenses and systems are NOT listed here on purpose. They are DERIVED: a building rung opens when building-tiers.json authors requiresVillageTier on it, its perks ride the same row, a troop opens when troops.json authors unlockBarracksTier on a barracks rung that the Heart just opened, and the population cap / echo workforce slots come from PopulationService and population-milestones.json. Listing them here as well would be the duplicated unlock table WO-2004's acceptance criteria forbid - the derivation IS the single authority. (4) REACH / INFLUENCE RADIUS - canon section 6 allows a Heart upgrade to expand buildable reach and owner ruling 12 requires the value be data-driven, but NO buildable-reach or influence-radius system exists in the tree (grepped across Assets/_Modules/Village/BuildMode 2026-09-06: zero hits). Authoring a radius here would be authoring a promise nothing can keep. It is a NEW FEATURE for the owner to rule on, not a missing number. (5) REWARD / MESSAGE METADATA - no reward grant path is wired to a Heart level. Every one of the five is a recorded gap in the WO-2004 reconciliation section, not an oversight. When one of them becomes real, add the field AND its production reader in the same change (AuthoredFieldReaderRegression fails a new authored string field that nobody reads).
